sections.title: Introductory Information
sections.content:
ITEM 7. MD&A

Automotive regulatory credits accounted for $1,790 million in 2023 compared to $1,607 million in 2022. Total automotive gross margin was 18.2% in 2023.

sections.title: Item 8. Financial Statements
sections.content:
ITEM 8. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS


| Revenues (in millions) | 2023 | 2022 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Total automotive revenues | $ 82,419 | $ 71,462 |
| Automotive regulatory credits | $ 1,790 | $ 1,607 |
| Energy generation and storage | $ 6,035 | $ 3,909 |
| Services and other | $ 8,319 | $ 6,091 |
| Total revenues | $ 96,773 | $ 81,462 |
